text.p: British jewellery retailer Signet Group Plc, formerly Ratners, said on Friday that like-for-like sales rose 8.6 percent in the four weeks to December 28, 1996, compared with the same period in 1995.
It said in a statement that like-for-like sales for the 11 months to December 28, 1996 increased 6.3 percent.
Signet said that in the U.S., where 60 percent of group turnover is generated, like-for-like sales rose 11.8 percent in the four weeks to December 28, 1996 and by 7.6 percent in the 11 month period.
James McAdam, Signet chairman, said, "The group's overall trading performance in the year to date has been in line with our expectations."
